type: sudo sh -c 'rm -f /tmp/probe.log /tmp/hscl-calamares.log; for i in $(seq 1 12); do echo "== start $i $(date +%T)" >> /tmp/probe.log; setsid /usr/bin/hscl-calamares >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 20; echo "start $i alive=$(pgrep -cf "[c]alamares")" >> /tmp/probe.log; pkill -f "[c]alamares-launch-normal"; pkill -x calamares; sleep 6; done; cat /tmp/probe.log; echo --wrapper--; cat /tmp/hscl-calamares.log 2>/dev/null'
